title.narrative: Technical Assistance for detailed engineering design for Kiritimati Island multi-purpose port (EIB)

description.narrative:
It is a priority of the Government of Kiribati the construction of a multi-purpose port in the island of Kiritimati. The Financing Agreement has been prepared to complete the necessary studies to proceed with the construction process. By implementing this action, the European Union will complete the studies and design of a port in Kiritimati so that construction can be effective once financial support is secured.

The following outputs will be achieved:

1.             Completion of technical, financial, economic, environmental and social feasibility studies for a multi-purpose port.

2.                  A detailed engineering design for Kiritimati Multi-Purpose Port including a structural engineering design of breakwater or wave breaker that meets international standards.

3.                  Structural engineering and estimated costing for the port, including operation and maintenance.

4.                  Set-up of the institutional arrangements for the operation of the port.

5.                  Production of the technical elements for an international tender for construction.
